california_uniform.interpretation: Actual parcel-rain subsets on the unchanged trajectory. Above-face onset follows the existing relaxed dry-theta path; it is not proof that cell-midpoint transport is wrong. Recipient RH/T are pre-step environmental values. Summed upward vapor can revisit interfaces/cells; it is not unique supply or a bound on possible climate rainfall. No alternate rain, entrainment or evaporation is applied.
